package.description: CR Studio 是创想三维出品的一款扫描仪软件，用于 CR-Scan 系列扫描仪。软件自带强大的模型处理能力，支持转台和手持两种模式，能导出 STL、OBJ、PLY 三种格式的 3D 模型及点云数据。

en-US.description: CR Studio is a scanner software by Creality for the CR-Scan series scanners. With powerful model processing capabilities, it supports both turntable and handheld scanning modes, and can export 3D models and point cloud data in STL, OBJ, and PLY formats.
